assertions.reason: The thermostat stays in the bank's cool mode until the period starts.
Nothing is written between the 15:30 cycle (which re-asserted the bank) and the period's start.
At the high-cost period's start (16:15) the bank ends and the comfort band is written once (the nearer edge, heat 68 F), the same write the 16:30 cycle made before #1405.

The band write at 16:15 leaves the bank's cool mode (indoor 68.5 F at the comfort floor: heat 68 F, so the AC stops). The setpoint number equals the bank target (68), so only the mode tells the band write from a bank re-assert.
No re-send between the bank end and the next cycle.
The regular cycle re-asserts the band as it always does.
The mode changed at 16:15, not at the 16:30 cycle (before #1405 it changed at 16:30).
After the bank no surface claims one (issue #1404).

After the bank the briefing quotes the band write actually made at the period start (the family the thermostat is armed in), not the day's mode (Issue #1404 end-of-bank mirror; it said the opposite mode before).

name: tou_home_cool_bank_ends_on_time_1405
description: Issue #1405: a home pre-cooled to 68 F (the comfort floor) for a 16:15 high-cost period. At the period's start the bank ends; before the fix the thermostat kept the bank setpoint until the next 30-minute cycle (here 16:30) wrote the comfort band. Now the Home/Guest bank-end timer (the mirror of the Away/Vacation T_start timer) writes the same band write at 16:15. The band write is heat 68 F: the same number as the bank target, so the mode is what changes (the AC stops at 16:15).

verdict.summary: A home bank ends at the high-cost period's start, not up to 30 minutes later
verdict.observed_behavior: The band write (heat 68 F) lands at 16:15; before the fix the first band write after the bank was the 16:30 cycle's.
verdict.expected_behavior: Occupant view: during the expensive period the thermostat holds the comfort band, not the pre-conditioning setpoint.
verdict.effectiveness: Fails on 6ebdb16 (no write at 16:15, the band lands at 16:30). Deleting the bank-end timer (_sync_tou_home_end_timer) fails the 16:15 row.
verdict.alignment: docs/scheduler-spec.md and docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md (Issue #1405) describe the Home/Guest bank-end timer.
verdict.user_outcome: If this regressed, a pre-cooled home would keep cooling to the floor (or a pre-heated one heating to the ceiling) for up to 30 minutes into the expensive period.
